title: One-Roll Malevolent Cult — What's So Horrible About the Faith

entries.value: Unbelievers are to be killed on principle
Hideous appetites of the flesh are sacred
Unholy entities from the Otherworld must be called
Unbelievers are property to be used as desired
The world must be purged to make room for the god
All settled civilisation must be destroyed
All law but the cult's must be overthrown
The god demands a terrible and constant nourishment
